messages:
nina: Ron in Sales flagged a Dedicated customer (NovaData) seeing p95 jump after "smart-routing" rollout. Reported ~1.4s p95 and brief 502 bursts on /v1/chat.complete. Can product triage?

ron-sales: customer id nova-221. Spike started ~01:44 UTC right after we pushed routing changes. They're on reserved capacity with a 99.95% p95 SLA. Example payload they sent: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.complete -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"explain..."}]}'
```
They reported latency correlated with a rise in backend queue depth and a few timeouts. Asking for immediate mitigation and ETA.

maria: marking this P0 for NovaData due to SLA. Tagging eng + SRE. Need p50/p95/p99, error counts, and last config diff for routing.

lee-eng: looking now. Early trace shows the smart-routing added an optimization that routes low-cost requests to a quantized variant when confidence < 0.6. For NovaData a small percentage (~8%) hit that path starting 01:43 and we see cache warm misses plus KV lookup latency on quant variant. That caused tail latency to spike and some upstream healthcheck flaps.

isaac-sre: can you paste the routing rule diff? Also need the model binary variant + kernel used. If KV cache invalidation occurred due to variant switch, KV warmup could add 800-900ms per affected request.

lee-eng: attaching diff snippet inline: 
```
- route: prefer=stable
+ route: prefer=cost-optimized if conf<0.6
```
Quant variant on that pool is redwood-2.1-q8_kv. Confirming kernel rev: k1.14.

anita-csm: NovaData is already on a renewal cadence next week. They are unhappy; please keep me posted with ETA and remediation steps. I'll coordinate customer comms.

nina: product asks: short-term patch vs rollback? Also add roadmap ask: per-customer routing pins + safer canary thresholds.

lee-eng: rollback of the routing rule for Dedicated pools is safest and fast. I can revert the config and push a targeted change to remove NovaData from the cost-optimized route in ~45m. Need infra to hold canary steady during rollback.

isaac-sre: I'll prepare a temporary mitigation: 1) pin nova-221 pool to stable+no-quant label, 2) increase healthcheck threshold to reduce flapping sensitivity, 3) grant transient extra capacity for 30m. I'll run the script after we coordinate a rollback.

maria: product acceptance criteria for the intake ticket: (1) p95 for NovaData back below 350ms within 90 minutes, (2) sustained 5xx <0.2% for next 2 hours, (3) customer notified within 60m, (4) postmortem with root cause and rollout checklist delivered within 48 hours.

nina: create intake ticket PRD-4218 and tag eng + SRE. Also capture rollback and re-rollout criteria: canary <=5%, no p95 increase >10% for 1 hour, and automated rollback toggle if error rate crosses threshold.

lee-eng: creating PRD-4218 now. Will include traces, config diffs, and a rollback PR link. ETA for rollback rollout ~45m.

ron-sales: I've told NovaData we have an engineer working and provided a tentative ETA. They asked for a temporary workaround on their side (reducing concurrency) while we fix.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: smart-routing v2026.03.16 applied 01:43 UTC 0% canary.

isaac-sre: after rollback I will add a short-lived alert: per-customer p95 jump >2x baseline for 5 mins -> page oncall and trigger per-customer routing pin automation. This will be part of the roadmap ticket.

maria: good. Post-action roadmap request: "Routing safety for Dedicated" scoped as a mid-sprint initiative: UX for pins, automated rollback playbook, and per-customer telemetry. Acceptance: demo pin UI + automated rollback in staging.

nina: immediate actions: (1) lee do targeted rollback, (2) isaac apply pin + capacity, (3) maria open PRD-4218 + notify CSM/anita. Keep thread updated.

lee-eng: rollback started. I'll post after p95 drops.

anita-csm: keeping NovaData updated, they appreciate the quick response.
